title: PID reuse window between pidfile read and kill
notes: Residual TOCTOU between _is_ember_server check and os.kill; _is_ember_server + /health cross-check are strong compensating controls

title: EMBER_SERVER_URL can redirect MCP to non-loopback target
notes: Misconfiguration vector: operator sets EMBER_SERVER_URL to non-loopback; state sent to remote host; same root cause as S-001 but operator-misconfiguration scenario

title: Config file loaded without integrity check
notes: config.update(json.loads(path.read_text())) accepts tampered config silently; tampered host value can expose server beyond loopback

title: Pidfile has no integrity check
notes: Plain text pidfile; _is_ember_server check is a strong compensating control; residual risk if attacker controls both pidfile and a process with matching argv

title: advise calls not logged with state/questions
notes: advise() in mcp_server.py logs server start/ready but not question IDs or model label per call; no post-incident audit trail

title: MCP logs are human-readable not structured
notes: logging.basicConfig format=[ember-mcp] %(message)s; no timestamp field, no request ID, not machine-parseable

title: model rm / uninstall --purge-models not logged
notes: models.remove() returns a string but writes no log entry; ember uninstall --purge-models deletes files with no audit trail

title: /health discloses PID and engine details
notes: GET /health returns pid + Engine.describe() including model_dir (full filesystem path); any loopback caller learns server PID and model directory

title: ToolError may include internal paths or server stack traces
notes: raise ToolError(f'ember server error {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}') forwards raw FastAPI error body to agent; may contain file paths or stack traces

title: uvicorn started without concurrency or timeout limits
notes: uvicorn.run() called with only host/port/log_level; no limit_concurrency, timeout_keep_alive, or backlog; connection exhaustion under flood

title: server.log grows without rotation
notes: open(paths.server_log_path(), 'ab') is append-only with no size cap; high-volume inference can fill disk

title: Multiple MCP autostart calls race to spawn server
notes: process.start() checks is_up() then calls spawn() without a file lock; concurrent autostart attempts can spawn two server processes

title: Model dir added to sys.path — path disclosure in tracebacks
notes: sys.path.insert(0, path) adds model dir for process lifetime; full path appears in import tracebacks forwarded via I-002

title: server.log captures all server output including potential state echoes
notes: Current code does not log state; prospective risk if future change adds debug logging of state/questions/answers

title: /metrics exposes model name device dtype
notes: ember_model_info{model,device,dtype} visible to any loopback caller; accepted risk per metrics decision; document in SECURITY.md

title: No access log on health/metrics endpoints
notes: uvicorn logs HTTP requests to server.log but not structured; no per-caller identity; acceptable for single-user loopback deployment

title: Arbitrary code execution via model-dir import
notes: joint_module() inserts EMBER_MODEL_DIR into sys.path and imports joint_schema_model.py as executable Python; attacker-controlled dir = ACE at model-server startup. Fixed in #57

title: Executable Python imported from attacker-controlled dir
notes: Same root cause as E-001; Tampering angle: code injection via model dir; fix: SHA-256 verify joint_schema_model.py before import. Fixed in #57

title: MCP trusts arbitrary server URL without loopback validation
notes: SERVER_URL accepted from env without validating hostname is 127.0.0.1 or ::1; attacker who controls env can redirect advise calls to exfiltration server. Fixed in #58

title: Model identity unverifiable — no weight hash check
notes: Pinned revision SHA used only at download time; load_clef() uses strict=True for tensor shapes but no cryptographic integrity check at runtime. Fixed in #57

title: EMBER_MODEL_DIR accepted without directory validation
notes: resolve_dir() checks is_dir() only; no validation of expected model files (joint_head_config.json, joint_head.safetensors, joint_schema_model.py). Fixed in #57

title: Unreserved media_kwargs forwarded to joint_schema_model
notes: RESERVED_MEDIA_KWARGS is a blocklist; all non-reserved keys pass through to joint_schema_model.systemone; switch to allowlist. Fixed in #58

title: EMBER_MCP resolves to arbitrary executable
notes: resolveEmberMcp() trusts process.env.EMBER_MCP without validating the path ends with ember-mcp; attacker-controlled env = arbitrary binary spawned as MCP server. Fixed in #58

title: No rate limiting on inference endpoint
notes: Any loopback process can flood /v1/systemone; engine lock serializes but queue is unbounded; add slowapi or limit_concurrency to uvicorn.run(). Fixed in #59

title: Default 262144-token context exhausts MPS memory
notes: max_length defaults to model maximum (262144); no per-request cap; large state can OOM the server; add EMBER_MAX_REQUEST_LENGTH cap. Fixed in #59

title: stop() performs destructive action with no audit log
notes: os.kill(pid, SIGTERM) and pidfile deletion in process.stop() with no log entry; add log.info before os.kill. Fixed in #60
